source_snapshot.items: Test connections between BMC I2C-5, RTC and IO expander
source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC run broad `i2cdetect -y -q 4` and forced `i2ctransfer -f -y 4 w1@0x6f 0x0b r1`; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect evidence/photos and check logs; no byte or second-endpoint oracle.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; substitutes physical probing for the explicit BMC transaction.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Flags bus mapping and `-f` risk but neither separates RTC/IO-expander coverage nor removes unsupported physical acceptance.

old_problem: BMC I2C-5-to-bus4 mapping,0x6f/register0x0b identity and expected byte, separate IO-expander endpoint/oracle, RTC time tolerance, driver ownership, forced-access policy and recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: The two endpoints are remotely testable, not Manual Only, but one forced byte read cannot prove both unless PID documents a proxy. RTC driver bypass can affect timekeeping and an IO read can affect latches, so ED-03/15 require device-specific read contracts and state-preservation evidence.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row136, same-row AI fields and history2525; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved bus4,0x6f,0x0b,r1 and both RTC and IO-expander coverage.
Required distinct endpoint evidence, RTC progression and unchanged clock/alarm/GPIO state.
Rejected blind scan, default `-f`, invented probing, state writes, retry and DUT action.

test_case.test_name: BMC I2C-5 RTC and IO-expander read-only connectivity
test_case.purpose: Verify BMC I2C-5 reaches both RTC and IO expander while preserving timekeeping, alarms and GPIO configuration/output state.
required_package: PID1114953 bus4 map and both endpoint addresses
0x6f/register0x0b device identity, semantics and expected byte
Separate IO-expander safe register/value mask unless PID proves a proxy
RTC encoding, reference/tolerance and time-progression rule
Kernel driver ownership, approved interface/forced-access exception and recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not scan broadly or use `-f` by default. After mapping and owner approval, capture time/alarm/GPIO/driver baselines; use supported driver read interfaces for separate RTC and IO-expander checks, retaining `i2ctransfer -f -y 4 w1@0x6f 0x0b r1` only under an approved exception; decode results and confirm all state is unchanged.
test_case.expected_result: Both PID-defined endpoints return their signed identity/status data; RTC time progresses within tolerance, IO-expander inputs/status match the oracle, and no clock, alarm, direction, output, driver or BMC health state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires independent RTC and IO-expander proof plus state preservation. One arbitrary byte, missing endpoint, time jump, unexpected GPIO/alarm change, NACK/timeout/driver error or management degradation fails.
safety_gate: Prefer kernel/daemon interfaces; `-f` needs explicit owner approval.
No broad quick-write scan or unknown register access.
Do not set time/alarm, GPIO direction/output or clear latch/status unintentionally.
Stop at first anomaly without retry/reset and preserve clock/GPIO evidence.
expected_evidence: PID bus/endpoint map and device identities
Driver ownership and vendor register definitions
Timestamped RTC values versus reference across interval
Pre/post time, alarms, GPIO, logs, bus/BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Approved reads should be state-neutral. On change/failure preserve evidence, stop, and use only project-approved RTC or IO-expander recovery; never rewrite time/GPIO merely to hide the fault.

source_conflict.reason: One undocumented forced read is used for two named endpoints and lacks mapping/value oracle; prior reviews add unsourced physical work.

blocked.reason: Both functional checks are identifiable; endpoint mappings/register contracts and driver policy are resolvable RPUC inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bus4 endpoint map, RTC and IO safe-read oracles, driver/force policy, time/GPIO preservation thresholds and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve both endpoint protocols and safe owner-controlled access, then revise the review layer.

project_authority: PID1114953 plus RTC and IO-expander datasheets/driver binding define the OEM mapping and safe register behavior.
